DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis

The patient's high fever (102°F), tachycardia (111/min), and tenderness of the uterus are classic signs of endometritis, a common infection of the uterine lining after delivery. The presence of minor bibasilar crackles is noted as well. I will proceed with imaging to further assess the pelvic region and confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound
